worker: pw-probe-runner | C; inside the XPC bundle; the host; yes; applies the specimen policy to itself; sandbox_compile_string, params, sandbox_apply; sandbox_extension_consume and sandbox_extension_release; one specimen; one application and all ordered phases; terminal publication exits without host permission

T5: posix_spawn; fd 0 policy pipe, fd 3 shared region, fd 4 ready pipe; optional fd 5 transient token channel | Policy delivery uses nonblocking writes under one absolute monotonic deadline (the worker_policy_transfer limit) beginning after spawn. Expiry closes input and enters cleanup before readiness or sentinel polling. The pipe carries no framing: the host writes the submission's byte count into the shared header before spawn, and the worker at EOF publishes the count it read and refuses a different length before compiling.
